tool_arguments.prompt: Fresh complete transparent RGBA single illustration of EXACT resting sea-lion animal in image1. Same watercolor, warm brown outline, golden-brown body, round dot eye, whiskers, tiny ear, resting short torso and proportions. Only turn its head and gaze naturally toward VIEWER RIGHT for a rightward teaching cue. Keep its body in same resting projection, no hand gesture and do NOT lift or invent any flipper. Exactly TWO foreflippers total: the one large near foreflipper resting in front of its belly and the one far foreflipper resting at lower left of chest. Exactly one paired rear-flipper shape at back of body. NO raised third foreflipper, no extra appendage on shoulder or chest. Entire subject visible on genuinely transparent empty background with generous margin. No floor, shadow, text, labels, clothing, props, decoration, aura, glow or background. Preserve round dot eye/no highlights and smooth connected anatomy. Image1 is identity and proportions reference for a NEW drawing, never mechanically mirror the input.
